inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> Qingyi from <Picture 1>, adult dancer with long oval face, high bun with jade pin, teal jade Hanfu and ivory fan.
<Subject 2> Hongyi from <Picture 2>, adult dancer with rounded face, half-up hair with gold floral ornaments, vermilion Hanfu and ivory fan.
<Picture 3> The exact opening composition: two women on the moonlit pavilion stage, Qingyi left, Hongyi right, exactly one chair at center.
<Video 1> The grayscale depth video for the source dance. It defines only the two dancers' body trajectories, choreography, chair interaction and timing. The target scene contains exactly one chair, at the center position shown in <Picture 3>.
<Audio 1> The original music segment paired with <Video 1>, used for exact beat and timing.

summary:
Generate a photorealistic 15-second, 9:16 Chinese historical duet dance. Retain the two distinct adult women and the moonlit pavilion, transfer the source dance from the grayscale depth reference, and show exactly one physical chair throughout.

retention_analysis:
Keep Qingyi's face, jade pin and teal costume distinct from Hongyi's face, gold ornaments and vermilion costume during turns and crossings. The first frame matches <Picture 3>. Preserve the dancers' motion timing and spatial trajectories from <Video 1>, but map the chair interaction to the single central chair in <Picture 3>. There is exactly ONE chair in the entire world: one seat, one back, four legs. Never duplicate, mirror, echo, reflect or add a second chair. No stools, benches, tables or extra furniture. Preserve the warm lanterns, moonlit pond, distant hills and timber pillars. <Audio 1> is the only soundtrack.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1, 00:00-00:15.000] A fixed portrait full-body view at 768x1344. The scene opens exactly as <Picture 3>: Qingyi in teal at left, Hongyi in vermilion at right, and the only wooden chair centered between them. The entire chair remains one coherent object with stable shape and position; never create a second chair or partial chair. The two dancers perform the continuous choreography of <Video 1> in temporal order: coordinated torso inclines, fan arcs, weight shifts, arm extensions, turns and steps around the chair. At chair-contact beats, hands touch the back of this same central chair; the chair does not move or multiply. Keep both dancers' full bodies and feet within frame, retain stable faces and costume colors when they cross, natural hands and foot contact with the wooden floor. The camera is locked; pavilion pillars, moon and pond stay still. Photorealistic cinematic moonlight with warm lantern fill. Exactly two women and one chair for every frame. No cuts, extra people, furniture, additional chair silhouettes, text, titles, subtitles, watermarks or dialogue.

overall_soundscape:
Only the original music <Audio 1>, synchronized with the choreography; no dialogue or added sounds.

non_diegetic_music:
Preserve <Audio 1> as the soundtrack and rhythmic guide.
